title: 5 Hedge Fund Replication Strategy ETFs to Consider
主要内容: In Q1 2019, hedge funds showed strong performance, with the Hedge Fund Research index rising 5.7%, the highest since 2006. The rebound in U.S. equities reintroduced risk, boosting hedge fund gains. Kenneth Heinz, president of Hedge Fund Research, noted increased investor risk tolerance, leading to sharp gains. Despite taking in $3.18 trillion, hedge funds faced $97 billion in performance gains. The article highlights the potential lag in hedge fund capital and flow cycles relative to realized performance, suggesting continued asset growth and new investor allocations in 2019. It also discusses the use of ETFs to access hedge fund strategies, previously limited to high-net worth individuals. One example is the IQ Hedge Multi-Strategy Tracker ETF (QAI), which seeks to replicate the performance of the IQ Hedge Multi-Strategy Index. The fund is a "fund of funds" investing at least 80% of its net assets in the underlying index.
